title: The Navier-Stokes Announcement: A case study in mathematical values
author: Edgar Bering

metaphors.title: The Argonauts and their new country
metaphors.paraphrase: A crew of mathematicians sets out on a quest and discovers a new country, whose niche offers hospitality to others; proofs are roads that diverge and reconverge through a thick forest of confusion, a rich web rather than a single path.
metaphors.style_hint: A ship moored at an unknown coast with roads fanning into woods.

metaphors.title: A larger bomb, delivered faster
metaphors.paraphrase: The claim that a still more powerful AI will solve AI risk has the logic of an arms race: a larger bomb delivered faster surely will; scaling compute is called climate arson.
metaphors.style_hint: A silo beside a smouldering forest.

metaphors.title: Dashed against the rocks
metaphors.paraphrase: The loved community and its ideals, like a ship, have been dashed against the rocks by an organization the author finds repugnant.

metaphors.title: Currency of prestige
metaphors.paraphrase: Mathematicians' endorsement is a currency of prestige and a delicate social lever on AI companies' incentives, while the field risks being indentured to them for model access and compute.
metaphors.style_hint: A mint stamping coins next to a debt ledger.

metaphors.title: A community-owned model, Delphi
metaphors.paraphrase: The template is a Māori-language radio station's locally governed model: a mathematics-specific model, attributed and owned by its community.
metaphors.style_hint: A small radio station with its own server.
